items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Lena Horne would be my lover... Lena Horne was my girlfriend... I get to shoot Rochester and Lena Horne, later on in the picture

ctx.x: How were you chosen for that picture? Was that Nazarro's booking?

Yeah. Well, the way I got in that show, someone called me in the theater and figured I would be just the one that could become the go-between Rochester, Lena Horne and Ethel Waters. So there was a love scene that they put up so that Rochester would be the husband of Ethel Waters and Lena Horne would be my lover and we get into an entanglement concerning the love affair, which we did, which I got hurt doing, but anyway I
